scope: E013 five working cards; sparse-code equivalence and controlled correction do not establish application meaning or physical BER.

cards.formula: For h=[a,b], [I|P]h^T=0 iff a^T=P*b^T. If P invertible, b^T=P^(-1)*a^T.
cards.verification: 3337744 declared QC-normalized supports tested with exact1024-bit images; eight weight6 seed orbits recovered
cards.limit: Finite support/QC prior, not an exhaustive search of all possible dual vectors or transmitter descriptions

cards.formula: rank(G)=K, rank(H)=N-K and G*H^T=0 imply rowspace(G)=nullspace(H)
cards.source: Finite-field dimension theorem, instantiated in E013
cards.verification: N2048,K1024; rankH1024 and zero orthogonality residual. All1024 rows sparse weight6, columns weight2/3/4.
cards.limit: Equivalent representation in fixed receiver coordinates, not unique standard identity, distance or girth proof

cards.formula: H=[Hu|Hp]; Hp*p^T=Hu*u^T; if Hp full rank, P=(Hp^(-1)*Hu)^T
cards.verification: rankHp1024; reverse GF2 solve exactly reconstructs frozen E012 P
cards.limit: A redundant algebraic cross-check, not an additional independently received signal

cards.formula: For real Gaussian noise variance sigma^2, BPSK L=2*y/sigma^2. For circular complex noise E|w|^2=v, normalized BPSK L=4*Re(z)/v. L>0 favors bit0.
cards.verification: Real-symbol simulation uses true sigma; actual RF uses declared assumed scale0.02 after known-prefix normalization
cards.limit: Assumed likelihood scale is not independent RF noise measurement; no clipping min-sum is homogeneous under global positive scaling

cards.verification: Synchronous eta0.8,max60; known Hamming correction and valid-but-wrong-word counterexample. Real words unchanged, artificial flips corrected, strong simulated noise failures retained.
cards.limit: Zero syndrome proves membership only. Controlled results do not establish ML optimality, universal correction radius or channel performance.
